facts.text: Chagall signed in Latin letters with his surname and the year from his first Paris years, for example 'Chagall / 1910' at lower right on La Sainte Famille.
On the 1911 painting To Russia, Asses and Others the signature also names the city: 'Chagall 1911. PARIS'.
His 1911 drawing Hommage à Apollinaire is signed and dated in capitals, 'CHAGALL 1911', at lower right.

excluded: No crops: no CC0/open-access museum image of a Chagall work exists in NGA, Cleveland, SMK or Rijksmuseum; the Commons copies of his pre-1931 works rely on PD-RusEmpire or PD-US-expired claims that are doubtful for an artist who died in 1985, so they were left out.
